name: 'Validation'

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  GG_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

jobs:
  static_checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true # needed to typecheck mypy_primer

      - name: add gg aliases to PATH
        run: realpath ./gg >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - run: uv sync --locked

      - name: typescript typecheck
        run: pnpm run typecheck

      - name: zizmor
        # intentionally exclude workflows from the mypy_primer submodule. https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/784
        run: uv run zizmor .github --persona=auditor

      - run: pnpm run check

      - name: python typecheck
        run: pnpm run typecheck-python

      - name: ruff check
        run: uv run ruff check --output-format github

      - name: ruff format
        run: uv run ruff format --check --diff

      - name: pylint
        run: pnpm run pylint

      - name: validate docs
        run: uv run zensical build --strict

      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]

      - run: ./gg.cmd uv sync

      # currently commented out because this doesn't work on macos, see https://github.com/eirikb/gg/issues/289

      - name: npm test (pyright-internal)
        run: ../../gg.cmd uv run npm test
        working-directory: packages/pyright-internal

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
